newsitem.title: DENMARK: Landing seen ahead for high-flying Danish shares.
newsitem.headline: Landing seen ahead for high-flying Danish shares.

text.p: Novo Nordisk and Tele Danmark helped push Danish share prices to another new record on Monday, but dealers believed that the euphoric advances of the past three weeks were unlikely to continue for much longer.
"We are nearing a period where rises will fade and, in our estimate, the index will not go much over 130 during the next 14 days. The market is ripe for consolidation," a dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.62 point up, at 129.26,in healthy overall bourse turnover of one billion crowns. The KFX December future rose 0.25 point to 129.35 with 90 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Tele Danmark rose three percent to 301 crowns, up from 292 on Friday, buoyed by hunger for Deutsche Telekom's new issue and the premium prices it is expected to command.
Biotech star Novo Nordisk climbed 20 crowns to 992 -- a two percent gain -- but dealers were at a loss to explain why.
"There's no special reason to explain the increase, but sometimes an order just comes along that makes a share rise," a dealer said.
Moving the other way were the top two banks. Den Danske Bank fell three crowns to 435 and Unibank slipped one crown to 283.
